:module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_s3_object.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references

module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons has an explicit depends_on on :resource.aws_s3_object.this, but this dependency is already established implicitly: the spark_history_server_helm_config variable interpolates ${aws_s3_object.this.key} (and ${aws_s3_bucket.this.id}) into the addon's Helm values, so Terraform already orders the addons module after the S3 object. The explicit depends_on entry can be removed.
